استعملن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْمَلْنَ (istaʕmalna) /is.taʕ.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# اُسْتُعْمِلْنَ (ustuʕmilna) /us.tuʕ.mil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# اِسْتَعْمِلْنَ (istaʕmilna) /is.taʕ.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
